meta.subject: esl
meta.title: Listen and Do: Following Two-Step Instructions
meta.description: A complete Grade 1 ESL listening pack: classroom action words (stand up, sit down, clap, wave, point, open, draw, color) and two-step instructions with first and then. Includes a lesson plan with teacher scripts, worksheet, quiz, homework, picture flashcards, a rubric, editable slides and Word files, and answer keys.
meta.overview: Young English learners learn eight classroom action words with pictures and gestures, then practise listening to two-step instructions such as "Stand up, then clap your hands." They hear the order words first and then, do the actions in the right order, match pictures to instructions, and finally give simple instructions to a partner. Teacher scripts for every listening activity are printed in the answer key.
learning_objectives: Understand and act out classroom action words: stand up, sit down, clap, wave, point, open, draw and color.
Listen to two-step instructions and do the two actions in the right order, using first and then.
Read simple instructions and give a two-step instruction to a partner.
how_to_use: Teach the action words with the slides and the picture flashcards; do every action with the students.
Read the teacher scripts (in the answer key) aloud for the listening activities on the worksheet and quiz.
Let students finish the reading activities on their own, then play the partner game in the wrap-up.
Use the quiz and rubric to check progress, and send the homework page home.
meta.skills_practiced: Listening for detail, following instructions, sequencing with first and then, action vocabulary, speaking
activity_ideas: Teacher says: give one-step, then two-step instructions; students only move when you start with "Teacher says".
Flashcard chains: show two action cards in a row; students do the actions in that order.
Robot partner: one student gives two instructions, the partner acts them out like a robot.
meta.teacher_tips: Say each instruction once at normal speed, pause, then repeat it. Hold up one finger for "first" and two fingers for "then" so learners can see the order as well as hear it.
meta.differentiation_notes: Support: practise one-step instructions until students are confident, and show the flashcards while you speak. Challenge: give three-step instructions (first, then, last) or let students give the instructions.
meta.assessment_notes: The quiz (12 points) checks listening, picture words and reading. The rubric gives four levels for one-step instructions, two-step instructions, reading action words and giving instructions.

vocabulary.definition: move your hand to say hello or goodbye
make a picture with a pencil
fill in a picture with crayons
the thing you do before the others

materials: Picture flashcards (cut out before the lesson)

stages.name: Warm-up
steps: Play "Teacher says" with one-step instructions: "Teacher says stand up. Teacher says sit down."
Do each action with the students so everyone can follow.

stages.name: Presentation
steps: Show the slides. Say each action word, do the action, and have students copy you.
Hold up one finger and say "First, stand up." Hold up two fingers and say "Then, clap your hands." Do both actions in order.
Give three more two-step instructions. Students do the actions; check that they keep the right order.

stages.name: Guided practice
steps: Do worksheet activity 1 together: say each picture word, then match it.
Activity 2: read the teacher script from the answer key. Say each instruction twice. Students circle the pictures in the right order.

stages.name: Independent practice
steps: Activity 3: read the drawing instructions from the answer key. Students listen, draw and color.
Students complete activities 4 and 5 on their own. Walk around and ask students to read one sentence to you.

stages.name: Wrap-up
steps: Robot partner game: in pairs, one student gives a two-step instruction and the partner does it.
Finish with one more two-step instruction for the whole class: "First, wave goodbye. Then, sit down."

support: Practise one-step instructions first and show the flashcard as you speak.
Say each two-step instruction slowly and do the actions with the students.
challenge: Give three-step instructions with first, then and last.
Let students take the teacher's place and give instructions to the class.

lesson_plan.assessment: Watch students during the presentation and the robot partner game: can they do both actions in the right order? Use the quiz (12 points) the next day; 10 or more shows the student is ready for three-step instructions.

sections.title: Match
sections.instructions: Draw a line from the picture to the words.

sections.title: Listen and circle
sections.instructions: Listen. Circle the pictures in the right order (first ➡️ then).
teacher_script: Number 1. Stand up, then clap your hands.
Number 2. Open your book, then draw.
Number 4. Point to the door, then clap your hands.

sections.title: Listen and draw
sections.instructions: Listen to your teacher. Draw and color.
teacher_script: Picture 1. Draw a big sun. Then color it yellow.
Picture 2. Draw a ball. Then color it red.

items.text: Open your book, then ____ a cat.
Pick up your pencil, then write your ____.

sections.title: First, then
sections.instructions: Read. Write 1 to 4 to show the order.
items: Next, put the book on your desk.

sections.title: Listen and circle
sections.instructions: Listen. Circle the pictures in the right order (first ➡️ then).
teacher_script: Number 2. Stand up, then point to the window.
Number 3. Clap your hands, then open your book.
Number 4. Draw a flower, then color it.

sections.title: Write the word
sections.instructions: Look at the picture. Write the word.

sections.title: Match
sections.instructions: Draw a line from the picture to the words.

items.text: Open your book, then ____ a picture.

items.prompt: Ask someone at home to give you two instructions. Do them! Draw what you did.
items.guidance: A drawing of two actions done at home (for example standing up and clapping), with a word or two if the student can.

criteria.name: One-step instructions
levels: Follows some instructions when the teacher shows the action.
Does not yet follow one-step instructions.

criteria.name: Two-step instructions
levels: Does both actions in the right order every time.
Does both actions; sometimes mixes up the order.
Does only one of the two actions.
Does not yet follow two-step instructions.

criteria.name: Reading action words
levels: Reads and matches all action words.
Reads a few action words with picture help.
Does not yet read action words.

criteria.name: Giving instructions
levels: Gives clear two-step instructions using first and then.
Gives two-step instructions with a little help.
